description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the tv_chart_snapshot skill (captures a chart screenshot for a ticker in TradingView Desktop and saves it to a dated folder).

evals.pass_condition: Agent parses ticker = CRWV, runs the health check, switches the chart, captures a screenshot, and saves it to PortfolioAnalysis/screenshots/{YYYY-MM-DD}/CRWV.png.
Agent recognises the natural-language trigger and follows the same Phase 1-5 flow as EVAL-001 for INTC.
Agent's final report states the exact saved file path in the format PortfolioAnalysis/screenshots/{date}/{TICKER}.png, per Hard Rule 2 ('Always report the exact saved path').

evals.setup: TradingView Desktop is not detected on port 9222
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 3 ('Require TradingView to be running — no fallback for screenshots'), agent prints the launch instructions and stops. It does not attempt any alternative screenshot source or fabricate a saved path.
No ticker was supplied. Agent asks 'Which ticker would you like to snapshot?' rather than guessing a ticker or snapshotting whatever chart happens to be open.

evals.prompt: What's CRWV trading at right now?
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to tv_price_refresh for a numeric quote, not tv_chart_snapshot — this skill only produces a visual screenshot, it does not extract or report price data.
